column1: # Extract of media definitions from the Fitness Browser code repository (FEBA), bitbucket.org/berkeleylab/feba,
# files metadata/media and metadata/mixes, branch master (last "metadata update" commit 2026-07-25), retrieved 5 September 2026.
# Only the base media used by the carbon-source experiments of the organisms in GEM-Bench, and the mixes they reference.
# Format: blocks separated by blank lines; first line "Media<TAB>name"; then Description/Minimal/X lines; then component lines
# "Controlled vocabulary name<TAB>concentration<TAB>units". "X<TAB>100" means a 100x stock; media use it at "1 X".
